metadata.title: Blue Capital Dungeon — extensive 3D route-network design

coordinate_system.reference: common origin in every projection; map zoom may differ

geography_notes: Principal E-W spans: 3,5,8,11,16 miles; terminal arms extend farther.
N-S dimensions and all node coordinates are design proposals, not prior canon.
No Violet nodes; the model stops at 17 miles, not a declaration that the entire dungeon ends there.
No constructed/carved bridges; any modeled link is a natural geological connection.
Projected line crossings are not junctions unless a shared node ID is present.
Nodes represent major junctions/regions, not every meter of tunnel or a fixed chamber size.
All passage accessibility, directional costs, fatigue and travel times remain OPEN.
No new story days or historical-site coordinates are assigned.
